subject.title: [Control UI] 部分模块中文翻译缺失

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker for the reported Control UI zh-CN tab interiors, or be superseded by the newer broader localization epic?
rationale: The reported Control UI tab gap is still valid, but a newer broad localization issue and several open conflicting PRs overlap this area; maintainers need to choose the tracker and landing sequence before more automated repair work is useful.

options.title: Keep this as UI tab tracker
options.body: Use this issue for the original Control UI tabs and route broader CLI, docs, runtime, and channel localization to separate issues.

options.title: Supersede into broad epic
options.body: Close this issue into the newer localization epic only after preserving the tab-specific source evidence there.

options.title: Consolidate PRs first
options.body: Pause new repair work until the existing tab-specific PRs are rebased, merged, or intentionally closed.

recommendation.title: Keep this as UI tab tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue for the original Control UI tabs and route broader CLI, docs, runtime, and channel localization to separate issues.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the strongest prior source-level coverage repair that was later used as the basis for the merged partial fix.
